headline: Brazil FGTS Council Extends Birthday-Withdrawal Loan Collateral Rule
summary: Brazil's FGTS council extended the regulation that permits workers to use up to five future birthday withdrawals from the severance fund as collateral for credit operations.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Modifications to severance fund collateral rules affect domestic consumer credit availability.
